_note: Template. Complete with domain knowledge before ge_naming_audit.py runs, starting from private/term_candidates.txt written by ge_terms.py. assemblies: every word, abbreviation and part number that names an assembly, lower case, one token per entry. Symptom words stay out: they are evidence and remain in the text. class_parts: the assemblies each label id stands for, as in label_map.json. references (optional): tokens containing the marker and a digit are added to an assembly when they carry one of its document numbers after the document prefix or start with one of its part-number prefixes, and to other_references otherwise.
